rows: Connect the calibrator to: A – Connector A on the red slot in x1L7X; B – Connector B on the blue slot in x1L7X
Check that the control valve is closed and that the hydraulic oil pressure is zero
Check that the clearance is between 30 and 50 thou for the gas control valve

sections_en.text: Oscillator calibration
A – Oscillator No. (1):

rows: Connect one voltmeter lead to pin (45) on the SOSG card in x1LOE and the other lead to earth, A com
Adjust the voltage and frequency to the calibrated value (the measurement can be taken from the calibrator) [A09R26] A com & .

sections_en.text: B – Oscillator No. (2):

rows: Connect one voltmeter lead to pin (45) on the SOSG card in x1LOG and the other lead to earth, A com, and adjust the voltage and frequency to the calibrated value (the measurement can be taken from the calibrator) [A10R28] A com &
If adjustment to the values in the table is not possible, replace the SOSG card with a new one and repeat the calibration.

rows: Calibrate the P2 pressure transducer (96FG) as follows:

sections_en.text: Determining the two ends of the control valve stroke:

rows: Run the unit on crank to obtain hydraulic oil pressure; the gas valve must be closed
Make a jumper on J2, J1 on the face of the SSVG card
Set the VCE value to Max by making a jumper between pin D10y and the common (Acom) on the calibrator
Connect the voltmeter to (A com & F11Y) & (A com & G12Y) on the calibrator, or between (A com & Out 1, A com & Out 1) & (A com & Out 2) on the face of the SSVG card, to read the servo valve voltage
Connect the voltmeter to measure VCE between pin H07 and the common on the calibrator
Achieve the following table, noting that the required VCE value is changed from the variable resistor on the SSKC card in x1L1T:
To test the LVDT fault circuit, remove the SOSG card in x1LOE; a Position Servo Trouble alarm appears

To test the fault circuit of the servo valve, make a jumper between Out1 and Out2 and the common on the face of the card; a Position Servo Trouble alarm appears and the red lamp on the SSVF card lights
Remove the jumper between Out1 or Out2 and the common
Disconnect all connections and terminals and stop the diesel

sections_en.text: Adjusting the stroke of the stop and speed ratio valve VSR:

rows: Check that the stop and speed ratio valve is closed and that the hydraulic pressure is zero, and check that the clearance is within 30 to 50 thou
Measure the output of 96SR from the adjacent box JB 25 between the blue and yellow wires No. 3, 4 on the terminal block
Adjust the Stability from R98 (2) on the SSVD card by turning 3 turns anticlockwise
Remove the SSVG gas control card from its place (control valve)
Make a jumper between J1, J2 on the face of the SSVD card
Set VCE to the MAX value by making a jumper between the common and D10y on the calibrator
Connect the voltmeter to measure the servo voltage of 90SR between pins (A com & G13Y) & (A com & G14Y)
Pick up the 20FG solenoid valve manually, or make a jumper on the control points of the valve in page 20F between [RTB2S (4) & RTB 3Q (2)] – [RTB 3S (2) & RTB 3Q (1)]
Adjust the VCE corresponding to the valve stroke according to the following table, noting that the required VCE value is changed from the variable resistor on the SSKC card in (1L1T):
To test the LVDT fault circuit, remove the SOSG card from its place; a Position Servo Trouble alarm appears on the alarm panel, then return the card to its place.
Trip the unit manually by means of the mechanical overspeed device (12 hectare); the stop and speed ratio valve is observed to close
Disconnect all connections and return the cards to their places.

sections_en.text: Governing pressure P2 calibration:

rows: Check that the hydraulic oil pressure is zero and that the stop and speed ratio valve is closed.
Disconnect the wires of the 96FG transducer from the adjacent box (JB 25)

Simulate the transducer output with VCE values by making a jumper between pin (H07R) and PFG (C03R) on the calibrator panel, measure the voltage and connect the voltmeter between pin (H07R) and earth, A com.
Simulate the turbine speed NHP using an oscillator and a frequency counter by making a jumper between the frequency source (C01), NHP (B02)
Connect the Freq. Count terminals between pins B02, Acom.
Connect a voltmeter between pin 45 of the SSVD card and the common, signal (TRD).
Make a jumper to cut off Firing by placing Logic 0 on pin x38 in the SSVD card so that the pressure governor can perform its function
Remove the SSVG card to prevent the control valve from opening.
Adjust the VCE voltage (transducer output) according to the following table:
Disconnect all the above connections, return the cards to their places, and check that there are no alarms and that the turbine is Ready
